name: id
description: Intake form identifier (1..N), one row per submitted sign-up form

name: channel
description: Channel the sign-up form arrived through: web, phone or paper; one third of the forms each

name: age
description: Applicant age in whole years (18-80); null when the applicant left the question blank, which happens on a few forms in every channel

name: income
description: Self-reported yearly household income in USD; null when the applicant left it blank, which paper forms do far more often than web forms
